sources.title: Vakbedrijf? Sluit je nu aan bij Solvari!
Solvari versterkt marktleiderschap met overname Offerte.nl
ISDE: Subsidie voor verduurzaming van uw woning

items.title: Solvari operates at material two-sided marketplace scale
items.summary: Solvari's current about page reports more than two million successful applications, 6,004 affiliated specialists, and more than 100 employees; Vortex independently presents the same broad scale with more than two million applications and more than 6,000 specialists.
items.implication: Request intake, professional account management, matching, communications, trust, and operations must be modeled as durable platform capabilities rather than a single lead form.

items.title: The business has shifted toward recurring professional revenue
items.summary: Vortex says it supported Solvari's transformation into a scalable, subscription-led platform and that recurring revenue now represents more than 60% of total revenue. Solvari's Pro pricing page presents tiered packages, optional credit bundles, CRM access, API access, marketplace and campaign entitlements.
items.implication: Subscriptions, package entitlements, credits, billing, and demonstrable ongoing professional value are core product concerns; lead delivery alone is insufficient.

items.title: Professionals need flexible control over fit and volume
items.summary: Solvari says professionals can choose leads in a marketplace, configure product or service, work region, and maximum lead volume, and flex the lead stream with sales capacity. The professional proposition spans more than 130 sectors.
items.implication: Service-area, category, capacity, campaign, eligibility, and marketplace-selection controls should be explicit bricks with immediate pause and adjustment behavior.

items.title: Matching combines automated location logic with human oversight
items.summary: Solvari's privacy disclosure says its own system proposes specialists using request data and distance between the home and professional, after which an employee checks the proposal before the request is sent.
items.implication: Matching needs explainable features, confidence, human approval and override, audit history, and clear data-sharing events rather than an opaque fully automated ranker.

items.title: Trust depends on admission checks and continuous feedback
items.summary: Solvari says new specialists must pass checks including valid Chamber of Commerce registration, consistent independently verifiable data, reachability, and blacklist screening before receiving its checked label; existing professionals are reviewed periodically and homeowner feedback informs quality controls.
items.implication: Professional verification, reputation, review provenance, periodic re-screening, and removal or remediation workflows must share one trust evidence model.

items.title: The homeowner and professional contract directly
items.summary: Solvari states that it brings consumers and specialists into contact but is not a party to the agreement they then make; users remain responsible for assessing offers, pricing, guarantees, certifications, references, and agreements.
items.implication: The product should make responsibility boundaries and comparison guidance explicit and preserve communications and outcomes without representing Solvari as the contractor of record.

items.title: Acquisitions make multi-brand migration a core capability
items.summary: Solvari's April 2024 Offerte.nl announcement called it the sixth acquisition in three years, named earlier Buldit, Offrea, and Casius acquisitions, described more than 5,000 companies and over 500,000 applicants per year in the combined network, and stated an expected 2024 total revenue of EUR 40 million. Vortex says it supported five strategic acquisitions that expanded geography and product offering.
items.implication: Identity linking, consent provenance, taxonomy mapping, attribution, contract migration, entitlements, reporting, and cutover observability should form an owned integration product rather than one-off projects.

items.title: Affiliate demand is an explicit paid supply channel
items.summary: Solvari's affiliate terms define tracked links, iFrames and API connections, category-specific lead generation, acceptance by Solvari, compensation per approved lead, monthly self-billing, and GDPR processor obligations when the affiliate uses an API.
items.implication: Affiliate onboarding, approved creative, consent evidence, attribution, lead acceptance, rejection reasons, reporting, disputes, and settlement require their own partner product and data assets.

items.title: Sustainability demand is shaped by changing public support and building policy
items.summary: The 2026 Dutch ISDE scheme covers qualifying insulation, ventilation, heat pumps, solar boilers, heat-network connections, and electric cooking for homeowners, while the revised EU Energy Performance of Buildings Directive seeks a fully decarbonized building stock by 2050 and requires national renovation plans.
items.implication: Project guidance and taxonomies must be date-, country-, building-, product-, and evidence-aware, while directing users to official eligibility sources rather than promising subsidy outcomes.

items.title: Review provenance and presentation are regulated trust surfaces
items.summary: The Dutch Authority for Consumers and Markets says businesses using reviews must take measures to ensure they reflect real experiences and explain how reviews are collected, selected, and scored. Solvari presents reviews and feedback as inputs to ongoing platform quality.
items.implication: Review collection, experience verification, fraud detection, moderation, ordering, score calculation, disclosures, and professional response rights require explicit governance and auditability.
